name: mkdv-grid
description: Illustrative full design over the four experimental variables: migration magnitude M, source count K, cultural distance D, and velocity V (as the number of years over which the same total arrivals occur). Expand it with `sweep --dry-run` before spending compute -- it is deliberately larger than anything worth running under the v0.1 null rule. Note the source_distribution axis: the reference baseline uses 'single', which is only valid at K=1, so any sweep over K must set a distribution that admits K>1. Expansion fails with the offending combination named.
